title: Pirate Weather API: daily timestamps drift by one hour after a DST switch because the tz object is reused
cause_short: Midnight computed once then +24h increments; after DST, each day's midnight appears as 23:00 the previous day; no error
fix: new tz object per day (v2.0i dev)
check_that_catches: local-midnight invariant on daily rows; DST-day row-count check
